Name: Tenant boundary
Description: A record may reference only records belonging to the same tenant unless an approved shared-master pattern applies.

Name: Immutable primary key
Description: Primary identifiers never change after record creation.

Name: Version check
Description: Updates require the current record version.

Name: Released version immutability
Description: Released estimates, contracts, document versions, events, and audit events cannot be edited.

Name: Effective date integrity
Description: Effective start must precede effective end and overlapping active records are prohibited where uniqueness applies.

Name: Money context
Description: A monetary amount must include currency.

Name: Quantity context
Description: A quantity must include compatible unit and dimension.

Name: Source preservation
Description: Imported values preserve source system, external identifier, import batch, and original value where transformed.

Name: AI writeback approval
Description: AI recommendations do not change authoritative records until the required approval is completed.

Name: Document checksum
Description: Accepted document content must have a validated checksum.

Name: Party master merge
Description: A party merge preserves all source identifiers, relationships, addresses, contacts, and reversal evidence.
Action: Create surviving master and merge history

Name: No silent data correction
Description: Failed quality or validation rules create explicit exceptions or rejected rows.

Name: Lifecycle integrity
Description: Inactive or archived master data cannot be assigned to new work unless policy permits.

Name: Audit completeness
Description: Material create, update, archive, merge, approve, import, and AI writeback actions create audit events.

Name: Retention inheritance
Description: A record inherits retention from classification, entity type, and governing jurisdiction.
